title: Cyber Security Consulting Expert
description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

You will consult and support cyber security operations across our business units and Group functions to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability across the company’s IT and OT assets, software-based products, and applications. Your main task is ensuring that cyber security policies, standards, controls, and regulatory requirements are properly understood and implemented. As a member of the Secure business enablement team, your main responsibilities are to maintain a high caliber of expertise on technical cyber security topics to act as a ‘center of excellence’ to the business and become a solution-oriented partner to the business. You partner with business stakeholders across the company and drive the adoption of cyber security practices and controls in line with the defined risk appetite and policy/standards (e.g., problem solve in projects to “get to yes” when it comes to considering cyber security) in all domains of IT, OT, IoT, and software-based products.

You will support, help, and consult all business units to execute cyber security operations across all domains (IT, OT, IoT, software-based products) through close and ongoing communication with business unit representatives. Furthermore, you collaborate with the internal cyber strategy, governance, assurance risk management team to identify fundamental gaps in cyber security execution in business units. You foster a culture of secure application development by assisting product teams in adopting secure coding best practices and frameworks and practices to ensure compliance.

Who You Are


 * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in intelligence studies, computer science, engineering, or related field.
 * Minimum of 5 years’ experience with a focus on cyber security risk management, policy setting, assurance, audit, or equivalent
 * Demonstrated experience and knowledge across multiple information security domains (e.g., IT, OT, IoT, and products)
 * Good knowledge of industry-leading Cybersecurity standards and groups: ISA, IEC, ISO, NIST, Namur, ENISA, BSI, and other Critical Infrastructure and Essential Services requirements
 * Capability to understand and take into account different business needs when executing cyber security operations
 * One or more industry-recognized security professional certificates (e.g. CISA, CISM, CISSP, CSSP)
 * Strong interpersonal communication, positive customer service, and effective collaboration skills
 * Strong analytical skills, problem-solving attitude, and capability to make decisions even in a hard situation
 * Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.g., German) is considered as an advantage+
   
   

Salary starts at 3,500 EUR gross, depending on relevant experience.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: Security Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Security Engineer to strengthen the security posture of our product. The role is focused on building and integrating security checks and validations directly into our CI/CD setup (ArgoCD-based) to ensure our systems are secure by design.

You’ll work closely with our Platform Engineering team to embed best practices in cloud-native security, monitoring, and observability, helping us scale reliable and secure infrastructure.

 

The remote work option is available to candidates residing and working within Slovakia.

 

 

Responsibilities

 * Design security validations for internal products
 * Integrate security measures into CI/CD pipelines utilizing ArgoCD and GitHub Actions
 * Work with platform engineers to support secure deployments in Kubernetes environments
 * Improve system and application visibility with observability and monitoring tools
 * Enhance internal security practices, tooling, and automation
 * Advise on security aspects of event-driven and service mesh architectures

 

Requirements

 * Proficiency in Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures
 * Familiarity with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows
 * Knowledge of observability tools like OpenTelemetry, Grafana, and Elasticsearch
 * Understanding of event-driven systems such as NATS
 * Background in service mesh technologies like Istio
 * Skills in using security monitoring tools like Falco
 * Understanding of data pipelines between producers and consumers
 * Ability to work effectively with Platform Engineering teams

 

We offer

 * Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, agile, software engineering culture
 * Benefit program (5 weeks of vacation, 5 paid sick days, meal vouchers, cafeteria and recreation bonuses, reimbursement of glasses, contribution to pension fund)
 * Referral bonuses for recommended candidates
 * English language courses
 * Great learning and development opportunities, including in-house professional training, career advisory and coaching, sponsored professional certifications, well-being programs, LinkedIn Learning Solutions and much more

 

Certain benefits and perks may be subject to eligibility requirements and may be available only after you have passed your probationary period.
workType: Information Technology, Engineering, and Business Development
sector: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Security Monitoring Analyst
description:
Summary

We are looking for a motivated and curious individual to join our Threat Defense R&D team as a Security Monitoring Analyst. In this role, you’ll help shape and evolve ESET’s security services and technologies, especially in the areas of threat hunting, incident response and EDR/XDR detection capabilities. You’ll work with cutting-edge tools and collaborate with some of the best minds in the field.

Job Description

Functional Responsibilities and Duties


 * Monitor and analyze global security threats and identify relevant events requiring attention.
 * Formulate hypotheses and conduct threat hunting activities across assigned environments or on a global scale.
 * Investigate security incidents, map attack paths and identify root causes.
 * Participate in global incident response cases (e.g. MDR customers, research-related cases).
 * Communicate findings and recommendations to internal teams and customers.
 * Contribute to the enhancement of methodologies, processes and infrastructure supporting the delivery of security services.
 * Prepare guidance and methodologies for MDR teams.
 * Participate in research of real-world attack techniques and help design detection logic for global EDR/XDR platforms.
 * Collaborate with Threat Research and Malware Analysis teams.
 * Continuously learn and share knowledge with the team.
 * Perform conceptual, systemic, creative and methodological activities.
 * Carry out other tasks according to the instructions of the direct manager in accordance with the activities of the department and the company.
   
   

Experience & Knowledge


 * Experience with EDR/XDR and/or SIEM platforms.
 * Background in threat hunting and incident response.
 * Experience as a SOC security analyst (or in a similar role outside of a SOC) where the primary responsibility involved operating and evaluating outputs from security monitoring systems to identify and report potential threats is a strong advantage.
 * Familiarity with forensic analysis, penetration testing or red teaming is an advantage.
 * Solid understanding of the inner workings of Windows and Linux operating systems (processes, registry, file systems, services, etc.).
 * Good understanding of networking technologies and principles (IP, ports, protocols, etc.).
 * Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.) is a plus.
 * Awareness of current trends and techniques in cybersecurity.
   
   

Soft Skills


 * Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
 * Proactive, curious and eager to innovate.
 * Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively.
   
   

Education & Certifications


 * Degree in IT or cybersecurity-related field is an advantage.
 * Certifications such as CEH, GCIH or similar are considered an advantage..
   
   

Languages


 * English: Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher.
   
   

Employee perks, benefits:


 * please visit our website: https://www.eset.com/sk/o-nas/kariera/benefity/
   
   

Basic wage component (brutto): from 3000 EUR

* The final basic wage component can be increased accordingly to individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

* Performance bonus 2 times per year up to 10% of the basic salary paid for the evaluation period(usually 6 months).

title: Security Specialist
description:
Summary

Do tímu internej bezpečnosti v ESETe hľadáme skúseného špecialistu/ku so zameraním na procesnú bezpečnosť, ktorá zahŕňa témy ako risk management, compliance, business continuity management, podpora interných projektov/interné bezpečnostné poradenstvo a security awareness aktivity.

Job Description

Ako člen/ka InfoSec týmu by si v závislosti od Tvojich znalostí a skúseností tiež riešil/a plánovanie a implementáciu Information Security Management System (ISMS), spracovanie risk assessmentov, podporu biznisových projektov a  definovanie a implementáciu bezpečnostných politík. 

Budeš mať na starosti: 


 * Realizáciu činností procesnej bezpečnosti v rámci riadenia informačnej bezpečnosti.  
 * Bezpečnostné poradenstvo v rámci dodávky interných business projektov.  
 * Definovanie a implementáciu bezpečnostných politík a štandardov.  
 * Operatívne bezpečnostné aktivity ako analýzy rizík, analýzy dopadu, DR plány, atď. 
 * Realizáciu činností procesnej bezpečnosti v rámci riadenia informačnej bezpečnosti 
 * Dohľad nad kontrolnými aktivitami internej bezpečnosti 
 * Konzultácie kolegom 
 * Aktivity spojene so zvyšovaním povedomia o informačnej bezpečnosti 
   
   

Takto si Ťa ideálne predstavujeme :  

Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti :


 * Chuť učiť sa a rásť v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti  
 * Aspoň 3 roky skúseností v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti 
 * Komunikačné zručnosti 
 * Samostatnosť 
 * Schopnosť pracovať na viacerých úlohách súčasne 
 * Analytické myslenie 
 * Samostatnosť, orientácia na kvalitu, schopnosť prispôsobiť sa novým podmienkam  
   
   

Jazykové znalosti :


 * Slovenský alebo český jazyk - potrebujeme kolegu, ktorý bude schopný komunikovať s tímami na Slovensku a v Čechách 
 * Anglický jazyk - Stredne pokročilý (B2) – potrebujeme kolegu, ktorý bude schopný komunikovať v angličtine 
 * Akékoľvek ďalšie jazykové znalosti sú vítané 
   
   

Výhodu budú mať kandidáti s nasledovnými zručnosťami a skúsenosťami: 


 * Skúsenosti s prácou na implementačných/vývojových projektoch 
 * Skúsenosti v IT alebo internej bezpečnosti prípadne podporené certifikáciou – SSCP/CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+ – pokiaľ nemáte, tak u nás ich získate 
 * Znalosť fungovania agilných metodológií, znalosť štandardov série ISO 27000 výhodou 
   
   

*Pozícia je zástup za rodičovskú dovolenku (ide o dlhodobejší zástup, nie je vylúčené ani ďalšie pokračovanie v spolupráci) 

Základná zložka mzdy (brutto): od 2700 EUR 

Bonus: Výkonnostná prémia 2x ročne až do výšky 10% zo zákl. mzdy vyplatenej za hodnotené obdobie (spravidla 6 mesiacov) 

*Finálna suma základnej zložky mzdy môže byť upravená v závislosti od individuálnych znalostí a skúseností vybraného kandidáta.

title: Cyber security
description:
Mzda: 1 900 € brutto/mesiac + variabilná odmena

Finálna výška nástupnej mzdy závisí od Tvojich pracovných skúseností a nadobudnutej praxe v odbore.

Čo majú spoločné metrá vo Viedni, v Kodani, v Istanbule či v Buenos Aires?

Sme to práve my! TOP 10 Najatraktívnejší zamestnávateľ Slovenska kategórií doprava a logistika za rok 2024.

Siemens Mobility má na svetovom trhu tradíciu už 120 rokov. Inžinierske centrum Siemens Mobility v Žiline vzniklo v roku 2003 s pár ľuďmi na palube. Dnes nás je už viac ako 650 a každý rok rastieme. Pracujeme na projektoch po celom svete a za našou prácou môžeme vidieť reálne výsledky – napr. najmodernejšie vlakové linky a metrá v najvyspelejších štátoch sveta. Staň sa aj ty súčasťou inovácií v doprave a buduj s nami lepšiu budúcnosť mobility po celom svete!

Ak je Vám blízka téma udržateľnosti a moderných riešení ste naším človekom! 🚅♻😉

Staňte sa aj Vy súčasťou svetovo úspešného Inžinierskeho centra v Žiline! Na oddelenie Cyber security hľadáme nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý/á bude v spolupráci s projektovým tímom pracovať na sieťových riešeniach, podľa požiadaviek na dátové a komunikačné spojenia a kybernetivkú bezpečnosť.

Čo bude Vašou úlohou?


 * Špecifikovať parametre riešenia, sieťovú štruktúru a topológiu
 * Navrhovať spôsob zabezpečenia siete a systémov
 * Analyzovať IT hrozby, riziká systémov a ich mitigáciu
 * Konfiguráciu Cybersecurity riešení a zariadení (DMZ, Firewall, IDS/IPS, Antivirus, Coreshield)
 * Vykonávanie bezpečnostných klasifikácií, TRA a bezpečnostných konceptov počas ponuky, realizácie a servisu železničných zabezpečovacích systémov
 * Vykonávanie hardeningu komponentov a v prípade potreby testovanie bezpečnosti
 * Účasť na technických stretnutiach so zákazníkmi, dodávateľmi a internými oddeleniami spoločnosti Siemens vrátane zahraničia
 * Istá miera cestovania (jednotýždňové až dvojtýždňové cesty na miesto, kde sa projekt u zákazníka realizuje)
 * Písanie odpovedajúcej dokumentácie a spolupráca s členmi projektového tímu
   
   

Čo od Vás očakávame?


 * Vysokoškolské vzdelanie v technickej oblasti (Informatika, softvérové inžinierstvo, elektrotechnika, telekomunikácie)
 * Minimálne 3 roky praxe v oblasti správy sietí alebo kybernetickej bezpečnosti
 * Znalosť sieťových technológií (TCP, UDP, IP, VLAN, vrstvenie OSI)
 * Plynulá znalosť anglického jazyka B2
 * Logické myslenie a spoluprácu v tíme
 * Ochota učiť sa a pracovať s novými technológiami a produktmi
   
   

Aké benefity Vám ponúkame?


 * Variabilná odmena
 * Flexibilný pracovný čas - balans medzi pracovným a súkromným životom
 * Možnosť pracovať z domu
 * Extra voľné platené dni:
 * Bridge days – v deň medzi sviatkom a víkendom máme v Siemens Mobility voľno
 * 3 Sick days za rok – na tieto dni nepotrebujete potvrdenie od lekára
 * Ďalšie dni voľna navyše - pri svadbe dieťaťa zamestnanca, pri sťahovaní sa zamestnanca, pri narodení dieťaťa na vybavenie úradných povinností, pri získaní Janského plakety a ďalšie.
 * 100% náhrada mzdy pri PN (10dní/rok) v prípade OČR (10 dní/rok)
 * Príspevok zamestnávateľa na III. pilier až do výšky 3 %
 * Podpora rodiny - príspevok pri narodení dieťaťa, príspevok na škôlku, KinderUni pre deti zamestnancov počas letných prázdnin, Mikuláš a iné
 * Wellbeing program (psychologické, finančné a legislatívne poradenstvo zdarma pre zamestnancov a ich rodinných príslušníkov)
 * Tréningový a rozvojový program (integračný proces, business a produktové školenia, e-learning, soft skills tréningy a iné)
 * Jazykové kurzy počas pracovnej doby s kvalifikovanými lektormi (anglický, nemecký jazyk)
 * Virtuálna peňaženka benefitov – finančný príspevok na voľnočasové aktivity podľa vlastného výberu
 * Akciové programy Siemens - možnosť investovať do akcií spoločnosti
 * Podpora športovej reprezentačnej činnosti
 * Budovanie komunity prostredníctvom podujatí ako – Deň Zeme, dobrovoľnícke aktivity či športový deň
 * Bonus za odporúčanie nových kolegov až do výšky 2 000 €
 * Skvelý team kolegov 😊 teambuildingy, firemné akcie a večierky
 * Stabilitu zamestnania, silné zázemie, dobré meno spoločnosti, zaujímavú prácu na medzinárodných projektoch, férový a ľudský prístup 😊
   
   

Nemáte pripravený životopis? Alebo potrebujete viac informácií? 🌍🚅

Napíšte mi na 📧 dominika.hamsik@siemens.com alebo sa môžeme spojiť prostredníctvom Linkedinu: https://lnk.sk/rhy5

Rada budem s Vami v kontakte pre budúcu spoluprácu. 😊

title: Penetration Tester
description:
Summary

Tím pentesterov v ESETe

Okrem bezpečnostných produktov ponúka ESET aj služby v oblasti bezpečnosti. Penetračnú testovanie poskytujeme na českom a slovenskom trhu už viac ako 10 rokov a postupne sme sa vypracovali na jedného z najväčších poskytovateľov týchto služieb.

Job Description

Oblasti, v ktorých pôsobíme, zahŕňajú testovanie webových, mobilných a desktopových aplikácií, testovanie sieťovej infraštruktúry a operačných systémov, sociálne inžinierstvo, rôzne technické audity – napríklad architektúry cloudových služieb alebo zariadení IoT, analýzu zdrojového kódu, testovanie formou redteam, poskytovanie threat intelligence a mnoho ďalších.

Do tímu hľadáme nového kolegu/yňu – či už s pokročilými skúsenosťami vrámci etického hackingu alebo aj motivovaných juniorov so základnými znalosťami pentestingu a motiváciou učiť sa.

Čo sa od teba očakáva?


 * samostatne zvládnuť celý projekt – od spolupráce na príprave testov a testovacích scenárov, cez samotnú realizáciu testu až po vypracovanie záverečnej správy
 * zvládnutie viacerých rôznych typov testov v oblastiach, v ktorých pôsobíme
 * schopnosť komunikovať – ozvať sa, keď narazíš na problém a podporiť ostatných členov tímu
   
   

Čo by si mal zvládnuť a čo budeš na pozícii potrebovať?


 * znalosti a všeobecný rozhľad v bezpečnostnej problematike a IT technológiách
 * schopnosť rýchlo sa učiť a samostatne hľadať bezpečnostné chyby
 * aspoň základné znalosti programovania
 * plynulá slovenčina/čeština a znalosť angličtiny (písanie správ)
 * dobré komunikačné schopnosti
 * praktické skúsenosti s penetračným testovaním
   
   

Zaujímavé môžu byť aj ďalšie skúsenosti:


 * praktické skúsenosti s prevádzkou IT v rôzne veľkých firmách
 * praktické skúsenosti s vývojom komerčného softvéru, či už pre servery, stanice alebo mobilné zariadenia
 * praktické skúsenosti v oblasti sieťových technológií
 * praktické skúsenosti s návrhom IT architektúry a prevádzky cloudových riešení
 * znalosť reverzného inžinierstva
 * hlbšie znalosti kryptológie
 * prípadne certifikáty súvisiace s touto problematikou (CEH, CPTE, OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, …)
   
   

Ak máte záujem, veľmi radi sa s Vami spojíme. Súčasťou výberového procesu môže byť aj challenge, kde prakticky overíme schopnosti kandidátov v oblasti hľadania chýb a písania reportov

Základná zložka mzdy (brutto): od 2000 EUR

*Finálna suma základnej zložky mzdy môže byť upravená v závislosti od individuálnych znalostí a skúseností vybraného kandidáta.

Bonus: Výkonnostná prémia 2x ročne až do výšky 10% zo zákl. mzdy vyplatenej za hodnotené obdobie (spravidla 6 mesiacov)

title: Skilled Writer/Editor – Cybersecurity Research and Threat Intelligence
description:
Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Writer/Editor to join our global Security Research Publication and Awareness Team.

Job Description

The core of the job is to edit, review and produce cybersecurity research publications for various audiences, mostly published on ESET’s blogging platform WeLiveSecurity.com. The role also entails participating in the creation of reports provided to customers of the ESET Threat Intelligence offering.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Cooperate closely with ESET’s global Threat Research team, helping researchers maximize the reach of their findings, in a joint effort to inform about current cyberthreats.
 * Edit and review cybersecurity research publications to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency.
 * Produce engaging and informative IT security awareness content tailored to various audiences, including technical and non-technical readers.
 * Participate in the production of Threat Intelligence reports for paying customers, as an editor and by creating regular digests from sets of in-depth technical reports.
   
   

Qualifications:


 * Advanced, native-like level of English proficiency.
 * Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills in English are a must; professional writing and/or editing experience in English is a plus.
 * Advanced analytical skills and ability to translate complex technical information into simple and engaging content.
 * Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality outputs.
 * Background and experience in cybersecurity or a related field are a significant plus.
 * Interest and knowledge in geopolitics and international relations are of advantage.
   
   

Basic wage component (brutto): from 2 500 EUR

* The final basic wage component can be increased accordingly to individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

* Financial bonus based on performance paid twice a year up to 10% from the base salary paid during the evaluation period (normally 6 months).

title: DLP Operations Specialist
description:
Join a team of cybersecurity professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient. As the Information Protection Specialist, you'll own the technical solutions to protect Swiss Re's sensitive data, monitor alerts related to data leakage, conduct regular analyses and monitor patterns to identify insider threats. What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises.

About The Team

The Security Team is the focal point for all security activities across Swiss Re. We are responsible for cyber security engineering and operations, governance, risk & compliance, operational resilience and corporate security. We define and implement the company's security strategy. As a part of the Security Team, the Cyber Security Operations unit is responsible for ensuring a timely response to cyber security threats and their overall management – ensuring a structured and timely resolution of anomalies, attacks, and incidents affecting our global business is in place.

Key Responsibilities


 * Use Swiss Re's Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) technical solutions to protect sensitive data across the organisation
 * Monitor and investigate alerts generated by the DLP solution
 * Interact and collaborate with stakeholders from different teams, regions and seniority levels to identify root cause and severity
 * Monitor activities/patterns to detect any anomalies from typical behaviour that may suggest insider threats
 * Conduct detailed and independent analyses on alerts generated by DLP solutions
 * Record findings on the DLP tool and ensure timely completion of each alert assigned to you
 * Continuously enhance processes to increase efficiency, reduce effort, and ensure robustness
   
   

Qualifications

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of cybersecurity and data protection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!


 * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
 * Familiarity with Cyber Security or Data Protection concepts
 * Proven experience with DLP solutions
 * Strong understanding of different data classifications such as "confidential, internal, sensitive and personal data"
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 * High level of emotional intelligence and active listening skills
 * Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion
 * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
 * Proactive attitude and autonomy
 * Ability to work independently and as part of a team
   
   

Nice-to-have


 * Certification in cybersecurity (e.g., Azure Security, CISM, CEH) is a plus
 * Experience with Microsoft Purview
 * Knowledge of regulatory requirements related to data protection and privacy (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
   
   

Role

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,200 and EUR 3,700 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:


 * the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 * the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
   
   

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.

Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

title: DevSecOps Student for Corporate Cybersecurity team
description:
We are looking for a motivated student to join our Corporate Cybersecurity team. You will work closely with our experts and contribute to improving cybersecurity practices across our organization. You will get exposed to several initiatives and projects and have the opportunity to gain practical work experience while pursuing your education.

Your role:


 * You will assist in evaluating application security tools and technologies that support our processes.
 * You will manage automated builds and deployment processes within Azure DevOps to eliminate manual work.
 * You will actively manage and monitor our cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, including backups and updating test stages.
 * You will assist, research and integrate security technologies for large-scale deployments.
 * You will build secure CI/CD pipelines incorporating application security tools to detect vulnerabilities early, preventing costly breaches while maintaining development velocity.
 * You will automate security testing across the entire SDLC with practical implementation of application security tools that reduce manual security bottlenecks.
 * You will use the DevSecOps Maturity Model (DSOMM) framework to systematically develop capabilities, level by level.
 * You will apply practical DevSecOps strategies and be involved in security testing such as, SAST, SCA, Container Security, Infrastructure-as-Code, Fuzzing, Vulnerability Scanning and more.
   
   

Your knowledge & skills:


 * Understanding of basic security concepts and related security frameworks/standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS or HIPAA.
 * Understanding of basic security vulnerabilities listed in OWASP TOP 10.
 * Familiarity with automation tools and scripting languages like Python and PowerShell.
 * Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language, e.g. C#, Java or C++.
 * Knowledge of the SDLC and experience integrating security best practices at every process stage.
 * Basic experience with DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) and infrastructure as code (IAC).
 * Good analytical problem-solving skills to scrutinize and solve very intricate security problems with effective solutions.
 * Ability to work cohesively with cross-functional teams and possess good communication skills.
 * Passionate about continued learning and being aware of current security trends and technologies. 
   
   

Your qualifications:


 * Enrolled in a Cybersecurity, Information Security, or related degree program (Bachelor or Master level)
 * Proficient spoken and written English, ideally B2 level or above
   
   

Basic salary component (gross) and other remuneration: The offered remuneration is from 8 € gross / hour. Depending on experience + after incorporation possibility to increase.

What we offer:


 * Long-term part-time job during your studies with the opportunity to gain experience in an international company and try out other positions
 * Possibility to work 20 hours a week with flexible working hour
 * Possibility of self-realization in an international corporate environment
 * Meal vouchers
   
   

How we work:

When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/sk

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
